To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
water security is perceived differently by different individuals.
water security is perceived as a state of mind that is based on context specific, localized and individualised perceptions, practices and experiences.
the stakeholders in the two study sites perceive that water security in their municipalities is a state of the mind based on localised perceptions and experiences of water threats and opportunities.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: 1) the state of mind of the stakeholders; 2) their perception of water security; 3) the water security challenges in the two municipalities; and 4) the response strategies that can be adopted by stakeholders to achieve water security.
how people experience water related issues in the two study area and how this experience influences the perception and practices of the people.
the state of water security and the role played by the state in achieving this.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the two municipalities have achieved water security for a small group of people.
the state of water security is not uniform in either of the two municipalities.
the state of water security is perceived to be low in Sekhukune and high in eThekwine.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
water security is perceived differently in the two study area.
the two municipalities have not achieved water security for their citizens.
water security is not an objective state but rather a subjective one.
The main takeaway from our work is that
water security is not only a physical phenomenon but also a social and political one.
water security is not a fixed or static concept.

the achievement of water security requires the development of a holistic and integrated response strategy that is based on localised perceptions of water security and that addresses the socio economic, political and environmental factors that contribute to the achievement of water and other forms of security.
